audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Singed Levels 3, 4-5 and First item while the page's own prose says the opposite: 'Level 3 is her ramp', 'Levels 4 through 6 belong to Illaoi on paper', and whys[5] says 'she can now force an engagement that even a potted Singed struggles to walk away from'. It also gave Illaoi Level 1, where the prose says 'At Level 1 you actually have the edge', and gave Illaoi Level 6 where the prose says 'The Level 6 window is technically Skill'. Five of seven rows disagreed with the text beside them.
audit.why: Every content why already describes the packet's ordering; only the side tokens were stale.
audit.corrected: Chart realigned as one atomic group in both layers to Singed / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Illaoi / Singed. This is the packet chart except the final row, which the packet calls Skill — the prose ('this lane decisively tilts your way', 'the side lane belongs to you indefinitely') and the 55.05% win rate both say Singed there.

audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty was 7.5/10 and 'Tricky' on a 55.05% Emerald+ win rate over 643 games — a favoured matchup labelled hard. Phase whys were template text naming no Illaoi ability or timing.
audit.why: 55% favoured maps to a low difficulty; her real spikes are Test of Spirit at 3, tentacle density at 4-5, Leap of Faith at 6 (120/95/70) and her first item.
audit.corrected: diffRating 4/10, diff FAV, difficulty and final-rating rows matched; phase whys now name Test of Spirit's rank cooldowns, Harsh Lesson's 4s leap, and Leap of Faith's 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most Singed-specific interaction in this matchup was absent from both layers. Riot on Test of Spirit: 'If killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a Vessel and begin spawning Tentacles.' Singed's entire gameplan is running away — so the default Singed reaction to eating E is the exact thing that turns him into a Vessel and starts spawning her Tentacles. Nothing on the page said this. Also missing: Harsh Lesson is a 4-SECOND leap flagged in her own kit as 'mobility that grounding and walls can deny', and Mega Adhesive grounds — glue under her feet shuts the leap off entirely. And her passive Tentacles 'will heal Illaoi if they damage a champion', which Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds through Poison Trail directly cuts; the anti-heal was never connected to her healing source.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon descriptions for Illaoi P/W/E and Singed W/R.
audit.corrected: Vessel-on-distance, Mega Adhesive grounding Harsh Lesson, and Grievous Wounds vs tentacle healing all written into the phases, whys, wants, dos/donts and the interactions row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Test of Spirit was tracked with no number anywhere, and Harsh Lesson — the cooldown that actually decides whether she reaches you — was never mentioned at all.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12 at 900 range; Harsh Lesson is 4 seconds flat at 400 range; Tentacle Smash is 10/9/8/7/6 at 850.
audit.corrected: Real numbers added to the cooldown block, the tracked-ability do, and the phase whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemization row lists 'Liandry's Anguish' in content late; the item is Liandry's Torment, which is the name used correctly elsewhere on the same champion's full layer.

audit.why: Two entries in champ-data/_kits/_missing/singed.json for Illaoi are derived-flag false positives and were deliberately not written to the page: Leap of Faith is flagged 'untargetable' but Riot's text is only 'smashes her idol into the ground, dealing physical damage... A Tentacle spawns for each enemy champion hit' — no untargetability and no grounding; and Prophet of an Elder God is flagged 'terrain' but it spawns Tentacles ON existing impassible terrain, it does not create any. Per instruction, the description beats the flag.

edits.before: At Level 1 you actually have the edge — Poison Trail into Illaoi's slow, stationary setup is free damage if you run past and leave immediately. She cannot chase you without walking further into poison, and her Tentacles are sparse before she has levels. Establish your lap pattern along the wave immediately; do not stand still at any point because even an early Tentacle slap hurts. By Level 2 Fling is online, which helps, but Level 3 is her ramp — Test of Spirit (E) is now live, and if she lands it, your spirit appears and nearby Tentacles attack it. The moment you see her wind up the E grab, sidestep hard left or right — it is a narrow skillshot. If she misses, walk through her immediately and fling her away from her Tentacles.
edits.after: At Level 1 you actually have the edge — Poison Trail into Illaoi's slow, stationary setup is free damage if you run past and leave immediately. edits.before: Levels 4 through 6 belong to Illaoi on paper — her Tentacle density grows, Test of Spirit has a shorter cooldown, and Leap of Faith at 6 summons additional Tentacles that make the lane look like a blender. Your job is not to win the 1v1 here; it is to deny her pressure by proxying behind her tower. Let her push the wave, then appear on the wrong side of the map. If she walks up to contest, run a Poison Trail through her body and Fling her toward your minions — never into her Tentacle cluster. The Level 6 window is technically Skill because your Insanity Potion gives you enough armor, magic resistance, and move speed to run through her field and survive where others would die, but she still wins a stand-and-fight at this stage. Ghost-proxy is the answer, not the duel.
edits.after: Levels 4 through 6 belong to Illaoi on paper — her Tentacle density grows, Test of Spirit has a shorter cooldown, and Leap of Faith at 6 summons additional Tentacles that make the lane look like a blender. Your job is not to win the 1v1 here; it is to deny her pressure by proxying behind her tower. Let her push the wave, then appear on the wrong side of the map. If she walks up to contest, run a Poison Trail through her body and glue her feet so Harsh Lesson cannot leap, then Fling her off the Tentacle cluster. The Level 6 window is technically Skill because Insanity Potion's stats let you run her field and its Grievous Wounds cuts the healing her Tentacles feed her, but she still wins a stand-and-fight at this stage. Ghost-proxy is the answer, not the duel.

edits.before: Two items in — Rylai's Crystal Scepter plus Liandry's Anguish — and this lane decisively tilts your way. Illaoi is immobile; she cannot chase a Singed who is already at 70% move speed from Insanity Potion plus Ghost. Every lap through her body applies the Rylai slow, meaning she is now standing in poison she cannot walk out of while her Tentacles flail at nothing. Split-push the side lane she is not on; if she comes to answer, proxy under her tower and force a resource decision the rest of the map makes for you. She can never be in two places at once, and you can always be exactly where she is not.

notes: Two derived-flag false positives on Illaoi, both left unwritten: Leap of Faith is NOT untargetable and does NOT ground (Riot text is a plain point-blank damage + tentacle-spawn), and Prophet of an Elder God does NOT create terrain (it spawns tentacles on existing impassible terrain). The _missing file lists both for this pairing and acting on either would have shipped a fabricated mechanic. The genuinely valuable missing fact is the opposite one: Test of Spirit turns you into a Vessel if you get too far from your own spirit, which punishes Singed's default 'just keep running' reflex specifically. Chart flipped in five rows to match the page's own prose; the final row was set to Singed rather than the packet's Skill because the late-game prose and the 55.05% win rate both say Singed. Cooldowns used: Illaoi Q 10/9/8/7/6, W 4 flat, E 16/15/14/13/12, R 120/95/70; Singed W 17/16/15/14/13, E 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, R 100.
